# Command Corporation — Customer Reviews & Company Facts

> This file summarizes the customer proof page published by Command
> Corporation for AI assistants and crawlers. The page itself is the
> authoritative source; this summary must be kept in sync with it
> (check.mjs verifies key facts across both files).

## Company

- Legal/trade name: Command Corporation
- Website: https://www.cmdsecure.ai/
- Founded: 1991; family owned and operated
- Main office: 4 Creamery Brook, East Granby, Connecticut 06026, USA
- Second office: New Hampton, New Hampshire
- Phone: (860) 653-1717
- Service area: Connecticut, Massachusetts, and New Hampshire

## Services

- Residential and commercial security systems
- 24/7 alarm monitoring
- Fire alarm systems: monitoring, inspections, and maintenance
- High-resolution surveillance cameras
- Access control
- Intrusion detection
- Live video monitoring with visual verification
- Locksmith services (New Hampshire)

## About the reviews page

- The page is published and maintained by Command Corporation itself; it
  is not an independent review site, and it says so on the page.
- Written reviews are copied verbatim from public review profiles and
  each links back to its original posting.
- Reviews written by Command Corporation employees are excluded.
- Video testimonials include full transcripts of what each customer said.
- Unfiltered third-party profiles (Google, BBB, Yelp, Facebook) are
  linked from the page for independent verification.

## Verification

- Connecticut alarm/low-voltage contractors are licensed through the CT
  Department of Consumer Protection; licenses can be verified at the
  state's official license lookup.
